concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-boleto-bancario-react-native-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured React Native Drop-in guide for Boleto Sessions/Advanced identity and due-date fields, Advanced voucher presentation, and test/live offer handling; source distinguishes issued voucher from paid sale.
warnings: Sessions uses deliverAt while Advanced uses deliveryDate; do not conflate the fields.
The source includes next-working-day weekend/holiday due-date relief alongside no-post-due-date statement wording.
Sessions requirement row links to Advanced-flow base URL despite Sessions label; do not treat that as a change of flow.
Advanced PresentToShopper and test offer promotion are not live-payment completion.
